note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0; library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz, read offline as owb-am), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 (Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). Every `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in its block (exact OWB pieces may be joined with '…'), including recitations without marks; it supersedes the earlier 1962 UBS wording and the self-rendered Old Testament. The text, Isaiah 9:6, is quoted in OWB's words wherever it is quoted (the blockquote, blocks 1, 2, 6, 8, 12; also the first study question); the names the sermon expounds one by one stay the traditional names in the author's prose, as do the title, summary and the other study questions. Allusions and the author's own paraphrases stay self_rendered.
